verdict.rationale: Galileo docs confirm alert functionality tied to metrics like cost spikes and hallucination rates ('get alerted whenever unexpected things happen... Your cost is higher than expected, Your model is hallucinating more than you want'), covering the error-rate/cost/eval-score triggering side of the story. However, no evidence specifies delivery via Slack, PagerDuty, or email integrations for these alerts. Missing for 10: documented notification channel integrations (Slack, PagerDuty, email), configuration UI/API for alert routing, and independent confirmation these channels work in practice.
